newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Intel EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said analyst Mona Eraiba increased the earnings estimate for Intel Corp to $9 per share from $7.50 for 1997.
-- said corporate spending for personal computers will be the key to Intel's earnings picture in 1997, "and we believe there is still significant upside in this market."
-- says introduction of MMX product, extension to both Pentium and Pentium Pro chips, will not leave surplus of those chips, and will allow for digestion of any leftover inventories.
